UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Patient or caregiver account profile storing display name, email, and preferred recovery language.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the patient or caregiver.

email.description: Verified email address of the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

RecoveryPlan.title: RecoveryPlan
RecoveryPlan.description: Structured hospital discharge recovery plan extracted by Gemini with medicines, conflict flags, diet, and red flags.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this recovery plan.

title.description: Concise title of the discharge episode.

hospitalName.description: Hospital or clinic name from the discharge summary.

patientContext.description: Short summary of diagnosis and procedure.

language.description: Active display language of the plan.

plainSummary.description: Plain-language explanation for patient and family.

dietPlan.description: Allowed foods, foods to avoid, and hydration instructions.

activityRules.description: Bounded list of activity and wound care rules.

redFlags.description: Bounded list of warning symptoms requiring urgent medical attention.

followUpAppointments.description: Bounded list of scheduled follow-up visits.

medicines.description: Bounded list of extracted medicine schedule items.

conflicts.description: Bounded list of drug interaction and timing conflicts.

clinicianNote.description: English SBAR handover note for clinicians.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the recovery plan.

DailyCheckIn.title: DailyCheckIn
DailyCheckIn.description: Daily patient symptom check-in and AI red-flag triage evaluation.

ownerId.description: UID of the recovery plan owner.

checkInDate.description: ISO date key for the check-in.

inputMode.description: Whether symptoms were entered via text or voice.

medicinesTaken.description: Bounded list of medicines confirmed taken.

matchedRedFlags.description: Bounded list of matched discharge warning signs.

DoseLog.title: DoseLog
DoseLog.description: Daily medication adherence record per dose slot.

ownerId.description: UID of the recovery plan owner.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of dose status update.

FollowUpReport.title: FollowUpReport
FollowUpReport.description: Doctor follow-up OPD note, lab result, or updated prescription merged into an existing recovery plan.

ownerId.description: UID of the recovery plan owner.

reportDate.description: Date of the follow-up visit or report.

doctorOrClinic.description: Doctor or clinic name from the follow-up report.

summary.description: Plain-language summary of the doctor's follow-up report.

changes.description: Bounded list of medication, dose, lab, or care changes extracted from the follow-up.

clinicianSummary.description: Concise English clinical summary for clinician handover PDF.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile containing email PII and preferred language; strictly owner-only.

/recoveryPlans/{planId}.description: Patient or caregiver recovery plans owned by ownerId.

/recoveryPlans/{planId}/checkIns/{checkI.description: Daily symptom check-ins scoped to a parent recovery plan.

/recoveryPlans/{planId}/doseLogs/{logId}.description: Daily medication adherence logs scoped to a parent recovery plan.

/recoveryPlans/{planId}/followUps/{follo.description: Doctor follow-up reports, lab results, and updated prescriptions linked to a parent recovery plan.
